[[John Siegler]] (movie) |colorscheme=Johto }} '''My Best Friends''' was one of the songs in [[Pikachu's Jukebox]] during the [[original series]], and featured on the [[Pokémon 2.B.A. Master]] CD. A portion of this song, part of the [[Finale]] to [[Pokémon Live!]], was used during the ending credits of the English [[dub]] for ''[[M05|Pokémon Heroes: Latios & Latias]]''.
